>
[Phoenix Fulu Holder](/Equipment.aspx?ID=3173)
</title>

<spoilers>May contain spoilers from Season of Ghosts</spoilers>

<traits>
<trait label="Rare" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=683" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=644" />
<trait label="Transmutation" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=157" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #199: To Bloom Below the Web](/Sources.aspx?ID=225) pg. 77

**Price** 2,000 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This elegant wooden frame is decorated with numerous downy red feathers that feel almost uncomfortably hot to the touch. A _phoenix fulu holder_ grants a sort of second “life” to any fulu placed for a time within its frame, but also gives the fulu wielder a stylish and eye-catching way of displaying such a treasure. You can place any fulu into a _phoenix fulu holder_ as an Interact action. 

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> Interact;  **Frequency** once per day;  **Requirements** An 11th- or lower-level fulu is stored in the _phoenix fulu holder_; **Effect** You take the fulu from the _phoenix fulu holder_, and an instant later, a glowing image of the fulu you removed manifests in the frame. If the previously stored fulu is consumed within the next 24 hours, the flickering image within the _phoenix fulu holder_ becomes a solid and fully functional duplicate of that fulu. This duplicated fulu functions identically to the original fulu, but if not affixed within 24 hours of its formation, it fades away and vanishes.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>
